closedHypothesis: Ordinary executable async Binary/Augmented primitive numbers/string pairs and primitive Unary already use ExecuteObservedValueOperation synchronously at Interpreter.cs790;generic async helper is not their actual consumer. Do not add another dispatcher/guard or retime this hypothesis.
finding: BinaryOperatorSyntax and ExecutableBinaryOperator have25 identical members in identical ordinal order. Instruction stores a dedicated int-sized enum field;compiler translates syntax->IR and runtime translates back for each general binary instruction. Small simple-return path also forwards through this mapping. Only5 production files name the duplicate enum/maps plus shared sync interpreter uses the forwarding helper;one test file has2 enum assertions.
proposal: Use existing BinaryOperatorSyntax directly in internal executable instructions. Delete only duplicate binary enum,compiler MapBinaryOperator,runtime MapExecutableBinary and trivial EvaluateExecutableBinary forwarder where consumers disappear. Rewire sync/async/shared simple-return consumers directly to existing operator routines. Keep unary/augmented representations and all arithmetic/protocol/stack/ownership kernels unchanged.
compatibility: Internal enum type changes,not public API or a persisted bytecode contract. Preserve normal syntax semantics/short-circuiting and explicit unsupported-operator failure;inspect And/Or compile routing before removal because runtime mapper excludes eager bool forms. No new validation table,dispatcher or representation framework.
acceptance: One frozen native compile/warm pair before edits for ordinary binary/mixed/comparison/helper calls,with augmented/unary controls;require same allocations,valid opcode counts/spans,fuel/errors and public Python results. Reuse exact integer/wide/admission tests,actual suspending rich/contains/arithmetic callbacks,aliases/cycles and58 full jobs. No architecture-only new tests;update existing enum references without changing useful assertions. No elapsed/CPython gain prediction.
stopping: Only binary operator kind;no unary/augmented/instruction-layout/VM/tagged-value/analysis redesign,global enum audit,owner/cache or retiming. Reject if a stable external bytecode boundary or new validation/lifetime machinery is required.
